rules.chamber: House/Senate = recipient committee linked by FEC ccl as principal (P) or authorized (A) committee of a candidate whose cn CAND_OFFICE is H/S, matched per FEC cycle (2021-2022 -> ccl22/cn22, 2023-2024 -> ccl24/cn24, 2025-2026 -> ccl26/cn26)
rules.chamber_fallbacks: no same-cycle ccl row: nearest other cycle with a ccl row decides (ties later) unless the same-cycle cm registers a non-candidate committee; a cycle linking it only D/J/U means not a candidate committee; no ccl row anywhere: cm CAND_ID of an H/S/P-type P/A committee; same-cycle cm type overrides a cross-cycle link of another office; office = candidate ID prefix where cn lacks the candidate
rules.other_bucket: not_house_senate_usd (sheet other_recipients) = presidential + party (cm type X/Y/Z incl. DCCC/NRCC/DSCC/NRSC) + pac (all other registered committees incl. super PACs, leadership PACs, JFCs, unauthorized committees, ActBlue/WinRed conduits) + unknown
rules.party: facts.party if D or R; else linked candidate's cn party (DEM/DFL -> D, REP -> R); else other (other_usd on the chamber row); dem_share = dem/(dem+rep)
rules.naming: the brief's 'other' bucket is not_house_senate_usd; sector_year_chamber.other_usd = chamber giving with party neither D nor R

decisions_recorded: Population read straight from the 8 pinned indexes (in place, immutable read-only); the payload files 04 names were not read (04 used them only for employee_tier).
sector_year_chamber carries 04's full grid 2019-2026 (2019-2020 missing rows, 2026 partial), 8 sectors x 8 years x 2 chambers = 128 rows, status/note copied from 04.

The brief's 'other' bucket is named not_house_senate_usd (sheets other_recipients and reconcile); other_usd on sector_year_chamber is the chamber's non-D/R party giving. Reason: one name, one meaning.
Hill committees (DCCC, NRCC, DSCC, NRSC) and the ActBlue/WinRed conduits stay in the other bucket (party / pac), per the brief; they are shown as of-which columns.

Other-cycle linkage used only when the committee has no ccl row in its own cycle ($69,311.43 of chamber dollars); the same-cycle committee type overrides a cross-cycle link of another office (Katie Porter's committee, 2023-2024, $16,467.18 -> Senate).
Candidate office from the candidate ID's first letter where cn lacks the candidate ($11,228.60).
FEC-registered H/S-type committees designated J (joint fundraisers) or U (unauthorized) are pac, not unknown.
gaps_and_risks: Conduit legs: ActBlue $27,309,972.80 and WinRed $8,620,860.56 (all sectors, 2021-2026) are in not_house_senate_usd; their earmarked candidates are only in memo text, which this link does not read. Where the candidate committee's own itemized report carries the same gift it is already counted in its chamber (both rows are in 04's total); unitemized small-dollar earmarks reach a chamber only through the conduit leg, so they are not in the chamber rows.
Hill committee money (DCCC/NRCC/DSCC/NRSC) is chamber-directed but is party money by the brief's rule; see of_which_hill_committees_usd.

One committee changed linkage between Mentat's July workbooks and the 2026-09-07 ccl26: BUILD THE BARN PAC (C00907923, formerly WAHLS FOR IOWA) is an unauthorized hybrid PAC in the active files, so its 2025-2026 receipts are other (pac), where Mentat's older map said Senate.
2026 is partial (through each index's max transaction date); 2019-2020 missing (cycle 2020 not collected).
life_insurance and auto_manufacturing have no Mentat data (as in 04).
